details.description: Stayfree has been providing superior feminine care products to women in India Since 1968. Their Stayfree Secure Ultra Thin Sanitary Pads with Wings offer exceptional comfort and protection during your periods. These extra-long pads, measuring 280mm, provide long-lasting coverage to prevent leaks, even during heavy flow. The innovative design is half as thin as a regular napkin, yet highly absorbent, using gel lock technology to convert heavy flow into a gel and lock it in. The dry cover and odour control system ensure a superior dry feel and keep you feeling fresh, allowing you to move freely and confidently without worrying about unpleasant odours. Crafted with your comfort and peace of mind in mind, these flexible, body-fitting pads are the perfect companion to help you focus on what matters most during your time of the month.

Elevate your period experience with Stayfree Secure Cottony Extra Large Soft Cover Sanitary Pads. Crafted with your comfort and protection in mind, these pads offer a superior fit and adhesion system with wings for maximum security. The extra-long 274 mm length provides long-lasting protection for up to 12 hours, ensuring you feel fresh and confident throughout the day. The soft-touch cover prevents rashes and skin irritation, while the advanced odour control system keeps you feeling clean and refreshed. Boasting a super absorbent design that stays close to your body, these pads absorb more and help prevent leaks, giving you the peace of mind you deserve during your heavy flow and overnight needs. Indulge in the ultimate in feminine hygiene perfection with Stayfree's Cottony XL pads, delivering all-day-long freshness and comfort round the clock.
details.usageInstructions:
Unwrap the napkin. Remove the paper on the backside of the pad and place it on your panty.
Remove the release paper from the wings. Wrap the wings around both sides of the panty and press firmly.
Before disposing of the pad in a dustbin, wrap it in the paper.
Do not dispose of the pad in a toilet or flush it as it may clog.
